title: Sightmap v1
description: A sightmap file: one YAML document under .sightmap/ describing views, components, requests, and memory entries. See https://github.com/sightmap/sightmap/blob/main/spec/v1/schema.md for the human-readable reference.

version.description: Must be 1 for files that conform to this version of the spec.

environments.description: Named deploy targets and each one's per-surface origins. Merged across every loaded file into one project-wide registry; on a name collision the first file by source path wins. See SEP-0014.

origins.description: Shared origins: hosts with the same URL in every environment, such as third-party endpoints. An environment's own origins override a shared entry of the same name. Never identifies a session. See SEP-0014.

url.description: File-level default representative URL, applied to every view in this file that does not declare its own. See the per-view `url`.

memory.description: File-level memory entries — surfaced whenever any definition from this file is active.

components.description: Global components — matched against every view. Entries may be either inline definitions or {"$ref": ComponentName} reference objects (see SEP-0002).

definitions.description: Shared component definitions — addressable by {"$ref": ComponentName} from any components: or children: list, but never matched on their own. A view receives a definition only where it references one, scoped by the reference's position. See SEP-0019.

requests.description: Global requests — matched against every view.

messages.description: Declarative console/exception patterns, addressable by name. Corpus-root only — no view-scoping. See SEP-0006.

signals.description: Named, reference-based state predicates — the Component/View subset of SEP-0007 point signals. A signal names an existing component or view and denotes the boolean of that entity's current state (component present, or view route active). Corpus-root only. See SEP-0007.

snapshots.$comment: Reserved tooling field. Not part of the spec's matching or merge semantics; conforming SDKs MAY ignore it. Consumed by the reference CLI's capture/probe workflow.
snapshots.description: Non-normative tooling field: named page states to capture for the views in this file (used by capture/probe tooling).

definitionName.description: An environment or origin name. See SEP-0014.

originUrl.description: scheme://host[:port] with http or https and no path, query, or fragment. Wildcards are allowed only in the leftmost host label (a label containing one *, or ** as the whole label) and as the port (*). See SEP-0014 Origin patterns.

originMap.description: Map of origin name to origin URL. See SEP-0014.

environment.description: A named deploy target. A web environment (the default platform) is identified by its origins; a native one (ios, android) by its app_id and optional build_type, and borrows a web environment's origins through backend. See SEP-0014.

platform.description: Which kind of deploy target this is. Defaults to web.

app_id.description: Native only: the bundle ID (iOS) or application ID (Android) the app reports. Compared byte-for-byte.

build_type.description: Native only: the build variant or configuration name the app reports, matched verbatim. Separates environments that share one app_id; absent covers every variant.

backend.description: Native only: the name of a web environment whose origins this environment borrows.

origins.description: Each surface's URL in this environment. Required for web; on a native environment, overrides the backend's entry of the same name.

memory.description: Freeform notes surfaced to agents at runtime in the [Guide] section.

selector.description: A CSS selector, or a list of alternative selectors tried in order.

route.description: Glob pattern matched against the URL pathname. * matches one segment, ** matches any depth.

environments.description: Names of the environments this view exists in. Absent or empty means every environment. Declarative only: not a route-matching input. See SEP-0014.

origins.description: Names of the origins (surfaces) this view is served from, resolved per environment. Absent or empty means unconstrained. Declarative only: not a route-matching input. See SEP-0014.

url.description: Representative URL for this view: a concrete address that resolves to it, used by tooling to navigate to the view (report, capture --all, sel-probe --all, discover). Falls back to the file-level `url` when omitted.

stability.description: Authoring-confidence marker. 'stub': a placeholder not yet fleshed out. 'deferred': intentionally left unmapped for now. Omit for an active view.

access.$comment: Reserved tooling field. Not part of the spec's matching or merge semantics; conforming SDKs MAY ignore it.
access.description: Non-normative tooling field: reachability of this view for the reference capture account.

tags.description: Open-vocabulary classification labels for this view. Resolved as a union across every view whose route matches the URL, not just the most-specific-wins view that supplies the active view identity. See SEP-0004.

properties.description: Named values read from the matched URL. A :name segment in the route binds implicitly and needs no entry here; an entry names a query parameter or renames a bound segment. See SEP-0008.

components.description: View-scoped components. Entries may be either inline definitions or {"$ref": ComponentName} reference objects (see SEP-0002).

componentOrRef.description: Either an inline component definition or a reference object {"$ref": ComponentName}. See SEP-0002.

componentRef.description: A reference to a component defined at file root in any sightmap file. Expanded inline before matching. See SEP-0002.

$ref.description: The name of a component defined at file root in any loaded sightmap file.

componentId.description: A component id: 4 to 64 letters, digits, '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit. See SEP-0020.

id.description: Stable identity of this component across versions of the sightmap. Opaque, unique among every component declaration in the sightmap, unchanged by a rename, move or edit, and never reused. A $ref placement takes its definition's id. See SEP-0020.

formerly.description: Ids of components this one replaces, for splits and merges. Requires id, and must not list it. See SEP-0020.

stability.description: Authoring-confidence marker. 'uncertain': the selector is a best guess. 'unstable': known to break across renders. Omit for a stable component.

properties.description: Ordered list of DOM-value extractions surfaced in enriched snapshot output. See SEP-0003.

tags.description: Open-vocabulary classification labels applied to matches of this component, e.g. "defect". Resolved as a union across every matching ancestor level, not just the nearest-enclosing match used for naming. See SEP-0004.

watch.description: Ask a capture consumer to report this component's visibility lifecycle (rendered, visible, gone) even when it is never interacted with. Applies to this component only, never its children, wherever its selector matches, whichever component names the element. A consumer's interactivity filter must not suppress it. See SEP-0015.

privacy.description: Whether a capture consumer may retain this element's content: block withholds it entirely, mask retains structure but not text, unmask overrides an enclosing mask (never a block). Applies to the matched element and its subtree, wherever the selector matches, whichever component names the element. The strictest declaration on an element wins; across ancestors the nearest wins, and block is absolute. Omission declares nothing. See SEP-0009.

children.description: Nested components. Selectors are scoped to the parent's matched subtree. Entries may be either inline definitions or {"$ref": ComponentName} reference objects (see SEP-0002).

componentProperty.description: A named value extracted from a matched component's node, resolved over the component tree. See SEP-0010 and SEP-0017.

name.description: Key used in the snapshot annotation (name="value"). Must be unique within a component. The name 'value' is reserved: it may be declared to override the AX built-in, but SDKs treat 'value' as the AX-value fallback even without a declaration.

extract.description: How the value is read. The object form is SEP-0017; a string (text | raw_text | attr=NAME | PATH.prop | exists:PATH) is the deprecated SEP-0010 form, accepted and lowered to the object during the deprecation window.
An extraction directive: a source and the value within it, with optional refinements. Which `from` values are valid depends on the entity. See SEP-0017.

from.description: The source to read from. See SEP-0017 Sources.

path.description: The value within the source: an attribute name, a state name, a component path, a body key path, a header name, or a stack frame address, per source.

pattern.description: RE2 regex (no backreferences or lookaround) applied to the resolved value. Capture group 1 is the value if present, else the full match. A value the pattern does not match is omitted.

join.description: Collapse every match of a component path into one value, joined with this string. Only valid with from: component.

componentExtract.description: An extract directive on a component property. See SEP-0017.

route.description: Glob pattern. Express-style :param segments normalize to *.

method.description: HTTP method filter. Case-insensitive; commonly GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE.

environments.description: Names of the environments this endpoint exists in. Absent or empty means every environment. A view-scoped request's effective environments are this list intersected with its view's. Declarative only: not a route-matching input. See SEP-0014.

origins.description: Names of the origins this endpoint is called on, resolved per environment. Absent or empty means unconstrained. Not inherited from an enclosing view. Declarative only: not a route-matching input. See SEP-0014.

tags.description: Open-vocabulary classification labels for this request. Every request definition that matches applies its own tags — there is no single-winner resolution to shadow, unlike components or views. See SEP-0004.

properties.description: Ordered list of value extractions, from the request URL (SEP-0008) or a body or header block (SEP-0005).

urlProperty.description: A named value a view reads from its matched URL: a bound route segment or a query-string parameter. See SEP-0008 and SEP-0017.

name.description: Key a consumer refers to this value by. Must not equal a :name binding the entity still produces; an entry reading from: url.path renames that binding instead.

urlExtract.description: An extract directive reading the matched URL: url.path names a :name bound by the entity's own route; url.query names a query-string parameter, matched case-sensitively, first occurrence, percent-decoded. See SEP-0008 and SEP-0017.

requestProperty.description: A named value extracted from a live request/response pair. See SEP-0005 and SEP-0017.

name.description: Key a consumer refers to this value by. Declaring one of the reserved request identity names (status, method, duration) shadows that identity; the reference CLI warns.

source.description: Deprecated: use extract. Which root to read from. See SEP-0005 §Extraction root.

field.description: Deprecated: use extract. Value to select within source: an object-key path for a body source, a header name (case-insensitive) for a headers source. Required when source is a headers source. See SEP-0005 §Extraction root.

pattern.description: Deprecated: use extract. RE2 regex (no backreferences or lookaround) applied to what field resolved, or to the raw source text when field is absent. Capture group 1 is the value if present, else the full match.

requestExtract.description: An extract directive on a request property: a body or header block (SEP-0005) or the request URL (SEP-0008). See SEP-0017.

message.description: A declarative console/exception pattern, matched by level and a message regex. See SEP-0006.

name.description: A stable identifier for this pattern, addressable by name by other tooling.

level.description: Exact, case-insensitive match against the observed record's level. Match-any if omitted. The reference capture emits log, debug, info, warn, error, and exception; an uncaught exception arrives as "exception", so level: ERROR does not match one. The vocabulary is open, so this is not an enum.

message.description: RE2 regex (no backreferences or lookaround) matched against the observed record's message text. Match-any if omitted. Compiled at validation time, so a malformed pattern is reported to the author.

source.description: Relative path to the source most likely to emit this pattern.

properties.description: Ordered list of stack-addressing value extractions for an exception record. See SEP-0006.

tags.description: Open-vocabulary classification labels for this message. Resolved as a union across every entry an observed record matches, so the classification survives an identity ambiguity that the name does not. See SEP-0016.

signal.description: A named, reference-based state predicate: the Component/View subset of SEP-0007 point signals. Evaluated online it is the boolean of the referenced entity's current state. See SEP-0007.

name.description: Semantic identity of the signal — a named boolean predicate, addressable by other tooling (e.g. as a completion or availability predicate).

ref.description: Name of an existing component or view this signal is about. Must resolve to exactly one; a name matching both a component and a view is rejected as ambiguous. Request and message refs are out of this subset.

tags.description: Open-vocabulary classification labels carried onto the signal, unioned with the resolved tags of the entity named by ref. See SEP-0016.

messageProperty.description: A named value extracted from an observed exception's stack. See SEP-0006 and SEP-0017.

name.description: Key a consumer refers to this value by.

source.description: Deprecated: use extract. Which root to read from. Only the exception stack is addressable in v1.

field.description: Deprecated: use extract. Frame and attribute to select: "<frame>.<attribute>" where <frame> is "top" (alias for 0) or a non-negative index and <attribute> is one of function/file/line/column. Required.

pattern.description: Deprecated: use extract. RE2 regex (no backreferences or lookaround) applied to what field resolved. Capture group 1 is the value if present, else the full match.

messageExtract.description: An extract directive on a message property: a stack frame attribute. See SEP-0006 and SEP-0017.

snapshot.$comment: Reserved tooling field. Not part of the spec's matching or merge semantics.
